desc: This reduced tool head flex is comparable to any high-quality single-stage press on the market. The primer catch system is fully enclosed to prevent spent primers and debris from spilling out, keeping benchtops and floors clean and clutter-free. A large frame opening with integrated LED lights illuminates the work area, making case insertion and bullet placement easier. The stainless-steel ram uses standard shell holders and features an anti-rotation retainer design to prevent shell holders from spinning during use. Compatible with most 7/8x14 dies, the press can load cartridges up to .338 Lapua length.
